verdict.rationale: Stripe's disputes docs say the Dashboard guides merchants through dispute responses and that Smart Disputes can automate evidence collection and submission. Terminal payments are managed in that same Stripe Dashboard. Chargeback notification is supported only by generic webhook events, with no dispute-specific alert documented, and response deadlines are never mentioned. Missing for 10: documented dispute/chargeback notifications (dispute event types or alerts), evidence of deadline tracking, Terminal-specific (card-present) dispute handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can get notified of chargebacks and submit dispute evidence before the deadline

citations.quote: To help you submit the best possible response for each dispute, Stripe guides you through the process in the Dashboard. Use Smart Disputes to automate evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes.
After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
You can manage both in-person payments and online payments in a unified system in the Dashboard.
